$comment: The idempotency-conflict vector referenced by Invariant I7 (spec/02-invariants.md#i7). Same key + same payload must replay the original result without re-executing side effects; same key + a different payload is a DuplicateRequest error, never a silent overwrite.

cases.description: identical replay: same key, byte-identical payload
cases.expected_result: the original recorded result is returned verbatim; no new provider call is made

cases.description: conflicting replay: same key, different amount
cases.expected_result: no provider call is made; no existing record is modified

cases.description: conflicting replay: same key, different currency
cases.expected_result: no provider call is made; no existing record is modified

cases.description: conflicting replay: same key, different method
cases.expected_result: no provider call is made; no existing record is modified

cases.description: conflicting replay: same key, different operation entirely
cases.expected_result: no provider call is made; no existing record is modified
